## Sissa's reward {#ss6-sissa .gs-lesson .gs-sissa}

::::: {.gs-sissa-layout}

:::: {.gs-sissa-story}

An old Indian **legend** tells of Sissa, who presented a board game to a king. Delighted, the king offered him a reward.

Sissa asked for rice: **one grain on the first square**, then twice as many on each successive square, across all 64 squares.

$$1,\quad 2,\quad 4,\quad 8,\quad \ldots$$

The king thought the request was tiny.

::: {.takeaway}

How large would this reward become?

:::
